text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh, my first winning concert is just
around the
corner!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I wonder how it'll go—what it'll feel like!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What if... What if I get to stand center
stage my
very first time?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Let's not get too ahead of ourselves!

text_block_list.text: I knowww. But I can't calm down.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I stop talking for an instant, I think the
nerves
might get the better of me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
After all, there's no guarantee I won't
totally mess
this up...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон can sing her heart out even
if
nobody comes to watch, but
apparently races are
different.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so? Do you really
think I can
win on dirt?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
This is my first step toward becoming a
top
Umadol! And I'm gonna take it firing
on all
cylinders! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
